finalText: Redis went down at 02:14:07 and never came back. Without the cache, your store got buried handling the full request load, queues backed up past the limit, and the system ran out of memory trying to hold all those pending requests. Worker-2 crashed from OOM at 02:31:44, and the API went unresponsive shortly after. Twelve reconnect attempts to Redis failed, so the service never recovered on its own. The outage lasted about 17 minutes until the supervisor gave up and killed everything.
